tools.name: article_create_draft
tools.description: Creates a new Article draft that can later be published.

tools.name: list_broadcasts
tools.description:
Returns the authenticated user's live-video broadcasts, or selected owned broadcasts when ids are provided.

At most one of `ids`, `max_results` may be provided. At most one of `ids`, `pagination_token` may be provided.

tools.name: get_chat_moderators
tools.description: Returns the authenticated broadcaster's persistent moderators as User resources. The list applies to all of their current and future broadcast chats.

tools.name: add_chat_moderator
tools.description: Adds a moderator to the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs. The list applies to all current and future broadcast chats.

tools.name: remove_chat_moderator
tools.description: Removes a moderator from the authenticated broadcaster's persistent list and returns the updated moderator user IDs.

tools.name: list_scheduled_broadcasts
tools.description: Returns scheduled broadcasts owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: create_scheduled_broadcast
tools.description: Schedules a broadcast for the authenticated user on one of their sources: `source_id` is required. Passing a stream key as `source_id` is deprecated and stops working when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027; pass the source's `id` from GET /2/sources instead.

tools.name: delete_scheduled_broadcast
tools.description: Deletes a scheduled broadcast by its alphanumeric broadcast id.

tools.name: get_scheduled_broadcast
tools.description: Returns a single scheduled broadcast by its alphanumeric broadcast id.

tools.name: update_scheduled_broadcast
tools.description: Updates a scheduled broadcast. Path `:id` is the broadcast id; the body must include `scheduled_broadcast_id`. Re-send every field that should be kept. Passing a stream key as `source_id` is deprecated and stops working when the /2/users/:id/sources and /2/users/:id/broadcasts routes reach end of life on January 1, 2027; pass the source's `id` from GET /2/sources instead.

tools.name: go_live_scheduled_broadcast
tools.description: Publishes a schedule that was created or updated with `manual_publish: true`. Without that flag the coordinator auto-publishes at start and this call is rejected.

tools.name: get_broadcast
tools.description: Returns a broadcast owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_broadcast_chat
tools.description: Returns newest-first chat messages for a broadcast owned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: mute_broadcast_chat_user
tools.description: Prevents a user from posting further messages in a running broadcast chat. When `end_at_ms` is provided, the mute expires at that time. The authenticated user must be the broadcast host or a moderator.

tools.name: unmute_broadcast_chat_user
tools.description: Allows a muted user to post messages in a running broadcast chat again. The authenticated user must be the broadcast host or a moderator.

tools.name: list_scheduled_calls
tools.description:
Returns the X calls on the authenticated user's calendar, earliest first: events on their X Calls calendar, and events on the Microsoft Outlook calendars they linked to X whose conference is an X call. Calls still running at start_time are included. The window defaults to the next 24 hours and may span at most 7 days. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`.

tools.name: schedule_call
tools.description: Puts an X call on the authenticated user's X Calls calendar, with them as its organizer, and invites people to it. The call exists right away: share its join_url, or put an agent in it at start time with POST /2/calls/:id/join. A recurrence (an RFC 5545 RRULE) repeats it. Invitees get an email unless notify_invitees is false.

tools.name: cancel_scheduled_call
tools.description: Cancels a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes, and takes it off invitees' calendars. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it. Cancelling what is already cancelled succeeds.

tools.name: get_scheduled_call
tools.description: Returns a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes or is invited to, at its occurrence running now or its next one within a year: its time, call, recurrence and who is invited and how they answered. Changes can take a few seconds to show here. Use scheduled_call.fields to select which fields are returned.

tools.name: update_scheduled_call
tools.description: Moves, renames or re-invites a scheduled call the authenticated user organizes. Only the fields sent change. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it.

tools.name: respond_to_scheduled_call
tools.description: Accepts, declines or tentatively accepts an invitation to a scheduled call for the authenticated user. For a recurring call, scope and occurrence_start_time pick the occurrences the answer is for: all of them (the default), one, or one and every one after it.

tools.name: get_chat_conversations
tools.description:
Retrieves a list of Chat conversations for the authenticated user's inbox, newest first: the most recently active conversation comes first. To find the chat with a particular person, start with participant_query set to their @username or name; with expansions=participant_ids, user.fields=receives_your_chat says how you can message each match. The unread, last_read_event_id and newest_event_id fields give your read state, computed from your latest read receipt and each conversation's latest notifying message. Request them with chat_conversation.fields=unread,last_read_event_id,newest_event_id.

The filters unread_only, type, is_archived, is_muted, participant_ids, participant_query, start_time and end_time are optional, and all filters must match (AND). participant_query keeps conversations where another participant's username, or a word of their display name, starts with the query, ignoring case and accents; with a leading @ it matches usernames only. It considers the 100 people who best match the query, uses only public profile information, and never matches group names, nicknames or messages. start_time and end_time apply to the time of each conversation's latest message.

Each page covers max_results conversations and returns those that match, so a page can hold fewer than max_results, or none, while meta.next_token is set and has_more is true: keep paging, passing meta.next_token as pagination_token. Once a page reaches a conversation whose latest message is older than start_time, has_more is false. A pagination_token only works with the same filters as the request that returned it; with other filters, the request fails with a 400.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`.

tools.name: get_chat_conversation
tools.description: Returns metadata for a Chat conversation including type, muted status, group details, and your unread state. For the unread state, request chat_conversation.fields=unread,last_read_event_id,newest_event_id: those fields give your read state, computed from your latest read receipt and the conversation's latest notifying message. Use chat_conversation.fields to select which fields are returned. Use expansions to hydrate member, admin, or participant user objects. Use user.fields to control which profile fields are returned for expanded users; in a 1:1 chat, user.fields=receives_your_chat on the participant says how you can message them: encrypted, unencrypted, or none.

tools.name: unarchive_chat_conversation
tools.description: Unarchives a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Unarchiving a conversation that is not archived changes nothing. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.

tools.name: archive_chat_conversation
tools.description: Archives a Chat conversation for the authenticated user only. Archiving an archived conversation changes nothing. Works for group and 1:1 conversations. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.

tools.name: get_chat_conversation_events
tools.description: Retrieves the events of a specific Chat conversation, newest first, with pagination support: messages, key changes, group changes, and read receipts. Events with an id above the conversation's last_read_event_id are unread: they come after the point you read up to. To collect them, page until an event's id is at or below it. Only `id` and `encoded_event` are always present. Events are either end-to-end encrypted or unencrypted, such as messages sent before the conversation was encrypted. Encrypted events carry `conversation_key_version`, and usually `conversation_token` and `message_event_signature`; treat an encrypted event without `message_event_signature` as unverified. An event without `conversation_key_version` is unencrypted. Decode each `encoded_event` client-side, and decrypt it with the conversation key named by `conversation_key_version` when that is present. A page holds up to `max_results` events and can hold fewer while `has_more` is true. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.

tools.name: add_conversation_keys
tools.description: Adds (initializes or rotates) the encryption keys for a Chat conversation. Call this before sending messages in a new 1:1 conversation, and again with a newer key version to rotate the conversation key. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID as the conversation id; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. The request body must contain the conversation key version and participant keys (the conversation key encrypted for each participant using their public key).

tools.name: send_chat_message
tools.description: Sends a message or reaction to a Chat conversation, which you can find with `participant_query` on Get Chat Conversations. Send it end-to-end encrypted by default: `encoded_message_create_event`, built with the Chat XDK. Plaintext `content` is only a fallback for a 1:1 chat that X Chat can't encrypt: use it only when the recipient's `receives_your_chat` user field (`user.fields=receives_your_chat`) is `unencrypted`. When `content` is refused, nothing is sent and the problem's `detail` says why; HTTP 400 https://api.x.com/2/problems/encryption-required means the chat can be encrypted or is a group, so send it encrypted instead. A recipient you can't message (closed inbox, system account, or a block) returns HTTP 403 https://api.x.com/2/problems/recipient-not-messageable.

tools.name: mark_chat_conversation_read
tools.description: Marks a specific Chat conversation as read on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient. Without action_signatures the conversation is marked read up to its newest event and the read receipt is unsigned. With one action signature over a MarkConversationReadEvent, the server sends that signed read receipt, marking the conversation read up to the event it names.

tools.name: send_chat_typing_indicator
tools.description: Sends a typing indicator to a specific Chat conversation on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.

tools.name: mark_chat_conversation_unread
tools.description: Marks a specific Chat conversation as unread on behalf of the authenticated user. For 1:1 conversations, provide the recipient's user ID; the server constructs the canonical conversation ID from the authenticated user and recipient.

tools.name: chat_media_upload_initialize
tools.description: Initializes an XChat media upload session. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

tools.name: chat_media_upload_append
tools.description: Appends media data to an XChat upload session. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

tools.name: chat_media_upload_finalize
tools.description: Finalizes an XChat media upload session. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

tools.name: chat_media_download
tools.description: Downloads encrypted media bytes from an XChat conversation. The response body contains raw binary bytes. A media item too large to return in one response fails with a 413 problem of type `https://api.x.com/2/problems/response-too-large`, and a retry fails the same way. Returns JSON with the response bytes base64-encoded in `data`, plus `content_type` and `size_bytes`. A response over 16 MiB is not returned: the call fails with a 413 `response-too-large` problem. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

tools.name: get_chat_message_requests
tools.description: Retrieves the authenticated user's pending Chat message requests from one inbox. Message contents are end-to-end encrypted unless the conversation is unencrypted. Accepting or deleting requests between pages can skip or repeat requests, and a page can be empty while `next_token` is set.

tools.name: get_chat_message_request
tools.description: Retrieves the message request state of a 1:1 Chat conversation and its newest message events. Like opening the request in an X app, reading it marks the returned messages as delivered and updates the unread badge.

tools.name: accept_chat_message_request
tools.description: Accepts the other user's pending message request in a 1:1 Chat conversation, which moves to the authenticated user's inbox. Without a pending request, including after a successful accept, the response is 404. Replying to a request does not accept it.

tools.name: search_communities
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Communities matching the specified search query.

tools.name: get_communities_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific Community by its ID.

tools.name: create_lists
tools.description: Creates a new List for the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_lists_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: update_lists
tools.description: Updates the details of a specific List owned by the authenticated user by its ID.

tools.name: get_lists_followers
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Users who follow a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: get_lists_members
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Users who are members of a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: add_lists_member
tools.description: Adds a User to a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: remove_lists_member_by_user_id
tools.description: Removes a User from a List by their ID.

tools.name: get_lists_posts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Posts associated with a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: media_upload
tools.description: Uploads a media file in one request and returns its id. Send the file base64-encoded in media (raw bytes in multipart bodies). For a Post, set media_category to tweet_image (JPG, PNG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB) or tweet_gif, then pass the returned id in media.media_ids on Create or Edit Post. DM media uses dm_image or dm_gif. For video, use Initialize Media Upload. Needs the OAuth2 scope `media.write`.

tools.name: search_news
tools.description: Retrieves a list of News stories matching the specified search query. Each returned story includes a `url` deeplinking to its x.com page.

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Retrieves news story by its ID. Each returned story includes a `url` deeplinking to its x.com page.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user's RTMP/RTMPS stream sources. A source's `id` is the `source_id` that POST /2/broadcasts and scheduled broadcasts take. Stream keys are not included; read one with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key.

tools.name: create_source
tools.description: Creates a persistent RTMP/RTMPS ingest point for the authenticated user. Push an encoder to `rtmps_url` with the returned `stream_key`. This is the only response that includes the stream key; read it later with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key.

tools.name: delete_source
tools.description: Deletes one of the authenticated user's stream sources.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Returns one of the authenticated user's stream sources. Poll it after starting an encoder and wait for `is_stream_active` before going live. The stream key is not included; read it with GET /2/sources/:id/stream_key.

tools.name: update_source
tools.description: Renames one of the authenticated user's stream sources.

tools.name: get_spaces_by_ids
tools.description: Retrieves details of multiple Spaces by their IDs.

tools.name: get_spaces_by_creator_ids
tools.description: Retrieves details of Spaces created by specified User IDs.

tools.name: search_spaces
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Spaces matching the specified search query.

tools.name: get_spaces_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific Space by its ID.

tools.name: get_spaces_posts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Posts shared in a specific Space by its ID.

tools.name: get_trends_by_woeid
tools.description: Retrieves trending topics for a specific location identified by its WOEID. `meta.location` describes that location: its `woeid` and `name`, and when they are known its `country`, `country_code`, `place_type` (`town`, `country` or `supername`) and `parent_id`, the WOEID of the place that contains it. Each returned trend includes a `url` deeplinking to its x.com search.

tools.name: get_posts_by_ids
tools.description: Retrieves details of multiple Posts by their IDs. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: create_posts
tools.description: Creates a new Post for the authenticated user, or edits an existing Post when edit_options are provided. Media in media.media_ids is attached in the order given; get the ids by uploading each image with Upload Media, or a video with Initialize Media Upload. Supports paid partnership disclosure via the paid_partnership field. To share a clip of another Post's video, set clip to that Post's id and a range of 5 to 60 seconds.

tools.name: get_posts_counts_recent
tools.description:
Retrieves the count of Posts from the last 7 days matching a search query.

At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided.

tools.name: search_posts_all
tools.description:
Retrieves Posts from the full archive matching a search query.

At most one of `start_time`, `since_id` may be provided. At most one of `end_time`, `until_id` may be provided. At most one of `pagination_token`, `next_token` may be provided. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_posts_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific Post by its ID. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_posts_liking_users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Users who liked a specific Post by its ID.

tools.name: get_posts_quoted_posts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Posts that quote a specific Post by its ID. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_posts_reposted_by
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Users who reposted a specific Post by its ID.

tools.name: get_usage_credits
tools.description: Returns the payer's developer-platform credit balance in USD. total_balance is max(0, prepaid_balance + free_balance); prepaid_balance may be negative.

tools.name: get_users_by_usernames
tools.description: Retrieves details of multiple Users by their usernames.

tools.name: get_users_by_username
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific User by their username.

tools.name: get_users_me
tools.description: Retrieves details of the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_users_me_followers
tools.description: Returns the Users who follow the authenticated user. Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/followers` with your own user ID, without looking it up.

tools.name: get_users_me_following
tools.description: Returns the Users the authenticated user follows. Same results as `GET /2/users/{id}/following` with your own user ID, without looking it up.

tools.name: get_users_public_keys
tools.description:
Returns the public keys that up to 100 users registered for X Chat encryption, looked up by numeric user ID. Each key carries the user_id of the user it belongs to.

Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version, juicebox_config and user_id.

tools.name: search_users
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Users matching a search query.

tools.name: get_users_by_id
tools.description: Retrieves details of a specific User by their ID.

tools.name: get_users_blocking
tools.description: Returns the Users that the given User is blocking.

tools.name: users_id_block
tools.description: Causes the source User to block the target User. A block also removes any follow between the two Users, in both directions, and unblocking does not restore it. Each call blocks one account: block only accounts the authenticated User named or approved, because finding or reviewing accounts is not approval to block them.

tools.name: get_users_bookmarks
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Posts bookmarked by the authenticated user. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: create_users_bookmark
tools.description: Adds one or more Posts to the authenticated user's Bookmarks. Supply `tweet_id` for a single Post, or `tweet_ids` (at most 25) to bookmark several in one request. Optional `folder_id` applies to every Post in the request. Billing and rate limits still apply per HTTP request.

tools.name: get_users_bookmark_folders
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Bookmark folders created by the authenticated user.

tools.name: create_users_bookmark_folder
tools.description: Creates a new Bookmark folder for the authenticated user.

tools.name: get_users_bookmarks_by_folder_id
tools.description: Retrieves Posts in a specific Bookmark folder by its ID for the authenticated user. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: delete_users_bookmark
tools.description: Removes a Post from the authenticated user's Bookmarks by its ID.

tools.name: get_users_followed_lists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Lists followed by a specific User by their ID.

tools.name: follow_list
tools.description: Causes the authenticated user to follow a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: unfollow_list
tools.description: Causes the authenticated user to unfollow a List by its ID.

tools.name: get_users_liked_posts
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Posts liked by a specific User by their ID. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_users_list_memberships
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Lists that a specific User is a member of by their ID.

tools.name: get_users_mentions
tools.description:
Retrieves a list of Posts that mention a specific User by their ID.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_users_owned_lists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Lists owned by a specific User by their ID.

tools.name: get_users_pinned_lists
tools.description: Retrieves a list of Lists pinned by the authenticated user.

tools.name: pin_list
tools.description: Causes the authenticated user to pin a specific List by its ID.

tools.name: unpin_list
tools.description: Causes the authenticated user to unpin a List by its ID.

tools.name: get_users_public_key
tools.description:
Returns a user's registered public keys for X Chat encryption.

Every key field is returned by default, so public_key.fields can be left out. It takes public_key, signing_public_key, identity_public_key_signature, public_key_version and juicebox_config.

tools.name: get_users_timeline
tools.description:
Retrieves a reverse chronological list of Posts in the authenticated user's Timeline.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: get_users_posts
tools.description:
Retrieves a list of Posts authored by a specific User by their ID.

When both are provided, `start_time` must be earlier than `end_time`. When both are provided, `since_id` must be less than `until_id`. Each returned post includes a `url` deeplinking to it on x.com.

tools.name: users_id_unblock
tools.description: Causes the source User to unblock the target User. Unblocking does not restore any follow the block removed, so blocking and then unblocking a follower removes them as a follower: do that only for followers the authenticated User approved removing.

schema.name: mcp__x__list_resources
schema.description: List available resources from MCP server 'x'

schema.name: mcp__x__read_resource
schema.description: Read a resource by URI from MCP server 'x'

uri.description: URI of the resource to read

tools.name: maps_regeocode
tools.description: 将一个高德经纬度坐标转换为行政区划地址信息

tools.name: maps_geo
tools.description: 将详细的结构化地址转换为经纬度坐标。支持对地标性名胜景区、建筑物名称解析为经纬度坐标

tools.name: maps_ip_location
tools.description: IP 定位根据用户输入的 IP 地址，定位 IP 的所在位置

tools.name: maps_weather
tools.description: 根据城市名称或者标准adcode查询指定城市的天气

tools.name: maps_search_detail
tools.description: 查询关键词搜或者周边搜获取到的POI ID的详细信息

tools.name: maps_bicycling
tools.description: 骑行路径规划用于规划骑行通勤方案，规划时会考虑天桥、单行线、封路等情况。最大支持 500km 的骑行路线规划

tools.name: maps_direction_walking
tools.description: 步行路径规划 API 可以根据输入起点终点经纬度坐标规划100km 以内的步行通勤方案，并且返回通勤方案的数据

tools.name: maps_direction_driving
tools.description: 驾车路径规划 API 可以根据用户起终点经纬度坐标规划以小客车、轿车通勤出行的方案，并且返回通勤方案的数据。

tools.name: maps_direction_transit_integrated
tools.description: 公交路径规划 API 可以根据用户起终点经纬度坐标规划综合各类公共（火车、公交、地铁）交通方式的通勤方案，并且返回通勤方案的数据，跨城场景下必须传起点城市与终点城市

tools.name: maps_distance
tools.description: 距离测量 API 可以测量两个经纬度坐标之间的距离,支持驾车、步行以及球面距离测量

tools.name: maps_text_search
tools.description: 关键词搜，根据用户传入关键词，搜索出相关的POI

tools.name: maps_around_search
tools.description: 周边搜，根据用户传入关键词以及坐标location，搜索出radius半径范围的POI
